reviews.text: Just wanted to say thank you to Caroline for grooming my two Frenchies she did an awesome job and my dogs were extremely pleased and happy. Look forward to continue doing business with them and would highly recommend prices were within reason and the job was exceptional. I think my fur babies found a new groomer
reviews.author: nelson medina

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of taking my dogs, Luna and Paulita, to Kar's for grooming, and I cannot recommend them highly enough! After three different places where Luna was sent back due to her behavior, we finally found a place that truly understands how to handle her.

The team at Kar's was incredibly patient and skilled, managing to groom Luna beautifully. Their expertise and care made a world of difference. Both Luna and Paulita looked stunning after their grooming session.

The excellent service we received was truly commendable, and I would wholeheartedly recommend Kar's to anyone looking for a top-notch grooming experience. They are 100% recommended!
reviews.author: Emiko Asa

reviews.text: My dog is very nervous and struggles with anxiety, so leaving her somewhere unfamiliar was really hard for me. When I picked her up, seeing how happy she was meant everything. She truly loves going there, and knowing that gives me so much comfort and peace of mind every time I drop her off.
reviews.author: Karla Cunliffe

reviews.text: My pup Astro loved his haircut! The best haircut my dog has gotten so far. The price was very reasonable. Appointment and payment are managed via a website which was very convenient. The only feedback I would give is to add a doorbell to avoid us having to call when we arrive. They sell wireless doorbells on Amazon for $30, that way you can place the button anywhere.
reviews.author: Mystery Guest
